name: Heat-Adaptive

intent_defaults.description: A warm-weather garment concept that explores ventilation, low bulk, movement and user-selected coverage.
intent_defaults.silhouette: User-adjustable relaxed fit with editable ventilation zones

component_defaults.ventilation: Optional vents or breathable panel placement

accessibility_defaults: Coverage, ventilation placement and sleeve geometry must remain editable.
circularity_defaults: Prefer construction that permits replacement of high-wear panels.
caveats: The name describes design intent, not measured cooling or heat-stress protection.
Breathability and thermal performance must be measured on the selected fabric and finished garment.
